review_candidates.title: Systems Administrator
review_candidates.description_excerpt: We are seeking an experienced and skilled Systems Administrator to join our growing IT team. The Systems Administrator owns the day-to-day administration, engineering, and automation of the Company's Microsoft platform estate — Windows Server, Microsoft Azure infrastructure and platform services, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, and Microsoft Intune. Working independently with general supervision, the Systems Administrator designs and implements system changes, builds automation in PowerShell
eligibility_evidence: This is a hybrid position, must be a commutable distance from our office in Conshohocken, PA.
